name: arena-saquarema
description: Controle de bar, estoque, comandas e day use da Arena Saquarema (futevôlei)

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
